annotations.title: Look up typical award sizes and labor rates

description:
For pricing a bid: what contracts in an industry (and state) are typically worth over the
    last three complete fiscal years (percentiles of award values by kind: definitive contracts,
    purchase orders, orders under vehicles; by set-aside and competition), and GSA schedule
    ceiling hourly rates (CALC+) for a labor category. Never a suggested price.

labor_category.description: A labor category for GSA ceiling rates, e.g. "senior software engineer".
labor_category.title: Labor Category

small_business_rates.description: Labor rates of small businesses only.
small_business_rates.title: Small Business Rates

state.description: A state code to narrow award sizes, e.g. "VA".
state.title: State
